{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The old square hums with local life and makes a gentle first hello to Cusco."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander the market aisles for street snacks and a proper taste of daily life."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Cristo Blanco gives you the city and the hills in one sweeping, free view."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Green Point keeps dinner easy on the wallet with bright, plant-based plates."}]}
